author: PC Gamer
text:
How to craft an engagement ring in Fields of Mistria
Oh no, when I said he was "endgame" I didn't realize marriage was also very endgame content.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Following its excellent Lord of the Rings cards, Magic: The Gathering's new Hobbit set is a bit of a second breakfast
It's nice to have, but it's more of the same.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Trent Reznor on Doom: 'In some ways I felt a parallel with what I was trying to do with music'
A new range of Nine Inch Nails Quake merch is out.

author: PC Gamer
text:
30 years after it 'ruined id Software,' Quake gets another big update while the studio once again grapples with adversity
New levels from MachineGames and archival development material have been added to the id Software classic in a free update.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Devolver Digital wants to get off the stock market, because 'the ongoing challenge of delivering growth in line with market expectations' just isn't worth the headaches
Devolver went public in 2021 and it's not working out.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Diablo 4's newest class barely made a splash with Lord of Hatred, but it's shaping up to be king of the next season
Warlocks finally get their time in the spotlight.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Capcom says it wants Monster Hunter Wilds to outsell World 'over the medium to long term,' but it'll need to muster a lot of sales momentum to get there
Wilds didn't rank in Capcom's quarterly best sellers, but the company hopes to turn that around.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Couple's dispute over playing Slay the Spire 2 in bed gets a ruling from comedian John Hodgman: 'Pick an arbitrary battle and stick with it'
Gaming in bed: awful or lawful? The man who played the PC in Apple's "Get a Mac" ads issues a landmark PC gaming ruling.

author: PC Gamer
text:
John Romero says id Software once sold empty Doom boxes to Taiwanese pirates so fans there could have legit copies: 'For us, it was distribution'
The id Software co-founder told the story during an opening panel at QuakeCon.

author: PC Gamer
text:
You deserve a travel power adapter you actually like for your next trip
Get rid of those oversized all-in-one chunks of plastic.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ghost Recon marks 25 years with a major update and free new missions for Wildlands, and a Ghost Recon: Future Soldier giveaway
We're going back to a "darker, more oppressive Bolivia."

author: PC Gamer
text:
New Kingdom Come trademark filings mention 'online' virtual worlds—but we shouldn't assume Warhorse is making a multiplayer game just yet
A videogame IP attorney says the filings are "far from a promise that the next Kingdom Come videogame will feature multiplayer."

author: PC Gamer
text:
It is genuinely cheaper for me to fly to QuakeCon and buy a RTX 5090 at the Nvidia booth than pick up the GPU absolutely anywhere else
Welcome to hell.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Larian gets briefly kicked off YouTube, TikTok for demonic smut reasons in Baldur's Gate 3
Hell, hell, hell has its laws. ToS, ToS, effects and the cause.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The first GTA 6 gameplay reveal will debut on Netflix later this month, as the streaming service tries yet again to get a piece of that videogame pie
Huh. Okay then.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Slightly ugly, and insanely functional': Check out this custom Steam Machine faceplate that doubles as a charging stand
They are apparently applying the finishing touches now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve explains clever shortcut for the Steam Controller's Grip Sense, and I'm starting to think it's a killer feature
This seems like a solid feature for the gyro heads.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword's incredible sword-fighting secret sauce explained: 'We really wanted to focus on creating this very realistic, grounded sword action'
So this is how you show elite-level sword techniques.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Microsoft quietly deletes 32 GB RAM recommendation, which I'm sure has nothing to do with it bringing back 8 GB laptops
Is 8 GB enough any more?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grab shopkeeper-dungeoncrawler Moonlighter free on Steam for a limited time
Two jobs for the price of none.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Can you play Big Walk alone or with randoms?
The most widely adored co-op game of 2026 is a bit tough on loners.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Former Bethesda lead artist is looking forward to Fallout 3's remaster because the game they released was '100% not what we intended, and it was very, very constrained'
"And you could only place so many lights."

author: PC Gamer
text:
What happens after GTA 6?
With the industry in flux, will Rockstar's big one create more chaos or calm things down? Probably neither.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance star is opening a real 'medieval-inspired bar' in Prague
Nobleman—proprietor Hans Capon, aka Luke Dale—will open to the public in October.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The guy in charge of EA Sports is now in charge of EA everything
With EA's acquisition by Saudi Arabia now complete, there have been a couple changes at the top.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Path of Exile devs are planning 'an extreme shakeup' in the next major update to address concerns over its stale endgame and lack of exciting loot drops
The action RPG's endgame won't look the same in patch 3.30.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Destiny 2 players are learning how to crack into its infamous content vault by tinkering with old game builds
Two months after it entered purgatory, Destiny 2's community archaeologists are creating tools for exploring its long-absent worlds.

author: PC Gamer
text:
You should really get Ace Combat 7 while it's 80% off on Steam, because AC8 might be one of the year's best games
Now this is dogfighting.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fields of Mistria officially becomes the best farm sim since Stardew Valley with its 1.0 update today
I'm joining the stampede to the altar now that I can get married in Mistria.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Black Library veteran Toby Longworth gives us his tips for voicing the perfect Space Marine
"I AM ENORMOUS AND WILL BE A DREADNOUGHT ONE DAY."

author: PC Gamer
text:
From ancient Buddhism, to iconic manga hair, to Keanu Reeves: a PC Gamer Causality Chain™
Would Xuanzang have liked John Wick?

author: PC Gamer
text:
BioWare veteran says Baldur's Gate 3 was such a great sequel because it didn't try to be too much like Baldur's Gate 2
Mark Darrah thinks Larian succeeded because it wasn't afraid to do its own thing.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Even with an $80 price tag, 'Grand Theft Auto 6 will be an incredible bargain,' Take-Two boss says
Strauss Zelnick reckons that the quality of the experience will more than justify the price.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two CEO says he expects the games industry to be in 'commercial streaming mode within 3 years,' which is great news if you hate owning things
Rockstar's parent company believes cloud gaming will grow its customer base even as hardware prices rise.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Big Walk patch addresses voice volume complaints with restraint: 'We consider it an important part of the game's design that you can only hear players who are close to you'
A new update "makes quiet voices louder overall," but doesn't let you hear players from farther away.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Japan has reportedly asked the US to stop using Mario, Pokemon, and others in social media posts
It's not just about the sanctity of copyright law anymore—Japan's foreign ministry is apparently worried that the US government is damaging the brands.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two boss dismisses hand-wringing over the end of disc-based games: 'Our business is well over 90% digitally distributed as it is'
Strauss Zelnick says Take-Two will still put out physical editions "now and then," but for the most part, the era of games on discs is already over.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Overwatch's new mech hero is the sword-and-board sequel to D.Va, except her code isn't 'a plate of spaghetti' under the hood
Blizzard set out to avoid the mistakes of the past with D.Mon.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Launch day performance issues and forced logins take another victim: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls sees mixed Steam rating, especially among Linux users
Ouch, that's gotta sting.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Asus ROG Zephyrus G16 (2026) review
The super-portable G16 is, in many ways, better than ever—but the memory crisis has priced it out of top contention.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The humble Wii Nunchuck has been turned into a video editing tool because it's 'one of the most ergonomic things ever made'
What a wonderfully geeky way to edit.

author: PC Gamer
text:
ChatTJB is a fake chatbot where a guy called Tucker Bryant answers queries himself: 'I tend to overcommit to bits'
Bryant will answer any questions asked (eventually) and will even scribble images for users.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW's changing how world bosses work because they've 'really been a little bit lackluster' in recent years, says dev
"A lot of players just cluster into a boss. It drops in a few moments."

author: PC Gamer
text:
'They call us old stupid farmers, you know, but we’re not': Family declines $26 million offer to convert their farmland into an AI data center
AI companies may have the cash to throw around, but some can't be bought so easily.

author: PC Gamer
text:
If your AMD chipset drivers are mysteriously failing to install like mine, you'll need to manually update instead
Something's borked with the AMD Install Manager, it seems.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sam Neill will reportedly star in the forthcoming The Legend of Zelda film
It'll be among the late actor's final screen performances.
